overview: Cornish Riviera Holidays is a family-run holiday letting agency based in St Ives and established in 1984, with its office in the Guildhall on Street an Pol. It manages a mix of fishermen's cottages, town houses and beachside apartments in the heart of the town, including studios and flats, and many are within a few minutes' walk of the harbour and the town beaches. Properties sleep anywhere from two to larger groups, many have free Wi-Fi, and there is a dog-friendly category for guests travelling with pets. The agency sponsors St Ives Surf Life Saving Club and runs a live webcam over St Ives harbour. Because it manages many properties, facilities, parking and prices differ from one to the next, so check the details of the one you are interested in.
surfTripFit: St Ives is one of Cornwall's best-known surf towns, with Porthmeor and Porthgwidden close to the centre and Porthminster in the town itself, so a self-catering base here puts you within walking distance of the beaches, cafes and harbour. Ask the agency which properties suit surfers best, including board storage, outdoor showers and drying space.
gaps: Property facilities, parking, dog policy and sleeping numbers vary by listing; the agency has been asked for surf-specific details and photos.
